comment: M6800 instruction table v2. Cycle counts verified against MAME's m6800 core (cycles_6800): all 197 documented opcodes matched exactly. flags_hnzvc / flags_read_hnzvc are 6-char HINZVC effects ('-' unaffected, '*' set by result, '0' cleared, '1' set), per the Motorola M6800 manual — shifts set V = N xor C (MAME's core leaves V untouched there; the manual is authoritative). The 'undocumented' array covers the remaining 59 opcodes (MAME illegl1/2/3 NOP behavior plus the real-silicon quirks 0x21 BRN, 0x87/0xC7 STA, 0x8F/0xCF STX/STS with EA=PC, 0x9D JSR direct) for a complete 256-opcode picture; the emu6800 crate only loads the documented 'instructions' map. flags_read / regs_read / regs_written / memory_read / memory_write are consumed by the crate.

undocumented.behavior: branch never (undocumented on the 6800; MAME brn)
undocumented silicon quirk: STA A with EA=PC (MAME sta_im)
undocumented silicon quirk: STS with EA=PC (MAME sts_im)
undocumented silicon quirk: JSR direct-page (MAME jsr_di)
undocumented silicon quirk: STA B with EA=PC (MAME stb_im)
undocumented silicon quirk: STX with EA=PC (MAME stx_im)
